# Copilot Instructions — mako

The instructions for this repository are in **[`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md)** at
the workspace root, with per-area detail in a nested `AGENTS.md` beside the code
it governs (`crates/edi-energy/`, `crates/mako-engine/`, `services/makod/`,
`xtask/`, and the domain-workflow crates — the closest one wins).

`AGENTS.md` is the cross-tool format every agent reads, so the guidance is
written once instead of once per vendor. This file exists only to point at it.
